evidence.MCL: Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Periligamentous edema, likely related to adjacent meniscal pathology.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Complex tearing of the medial meniscus body and posterior horn with dominant radial component at the posterior horn.
evidence.Medial OA: High-grade articular cartilage loss of the weightbearing aspect of the joint with confluent areas of full-thickness cartilage loss at the weightbearing medial femoral condyle.
evidence.Lateral OA: Articular cartilage irregularity and diffuse low grade cartilage loss at the weightbearing aspect of the joint with areas of high-grade fissuring.
evidence.PF OA: Confluent full-thickness cartilage loss throughout the patella with subchondral signal changes.
evidence.Contusion: Mild reactive subchondral bone marrow edema at the weightbearing aspect of the medial compartment near the medial joint line.
